name: notes-app
description: Production-ready Simple Note app with Bun, Elysia, React, and SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --filter backend dev" "bun run --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter frontend build && bun run --filter backend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter backend typecheck && bun run --filter frontend typecheck
